Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You begin with the detail you remember best, and the listeners lean a little closer.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
A few minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
A willing audience; a few minutes
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Ordinary conversation remains available. Choose a plausible objective before rolling; this does not compel belief or behavior.

Weak
1 progress toward engaging them; recognize one part of the story that visibly interests a listener.
Standard
2 progress, that interest, and a volunteered local detail.
Strong
3 progress, both details above, and an introduction to a willing listener.
